title: News Corp Files Daily Buyback Notice Under $1 Billion Program
summary: News Corp bought back 28,539 Class A and 12,422 Class B shares on November 11, 2026, under its $1 billion 2025 Repurchase Program.
body_markdown:
Before that day, the company had bought back 14,277,475 Class A shares for total consideration of $379,430,143.05 and 6,586,122 Class B shares for $197,163,956.13, the filings show. The company said it has purchased approximately $577,729,075 worth of Class A and Class B shares to date under the 2025 Repurchase Program, based on total consideration paid.


The program, authorized as of Tuesday, July 15, 2025, covers up to an aggregate of $1 billion of the company's Nasdaq-listed Class A and Class B common stock. The filings name Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC as the broker and state that no ASX-listed CDIs will be repurchased.


## Why It Matters for NWSA


News Corp gives the reason for the buy-back as "to enhance shareholder value," according to the filings. The company said it intends to repurchase a combination of Class A and Class B shares from time to time, in the open market or otherwise, subject to market conditions, the market price of its stock and other factors.
